label: Synthetic demo: gramicidin S + angiotensin II (HCD)
description: A small synthetic mzML written like ThermoRawFileParser output (plain mzML, zlib, 64-bit, centroided): 2 MS1 and 24 HCD MS2 scans of two precursors with 1.5 ppm noise and random noise peaks. Not real data. Expected precursor [M+2H]2+ of gramicidin S = 571.3602.
